## Escalate Case

Creates the Escalation with its ack clock, moves ownership toward the receiving role's on-duty member THROUGH Assign Owner (the single writer), and refuses a skip of more than one rung without override+note. The current rung is read from the subject's latest Escalation (`current`), so a caller cannot claim a higher starting rung. It sits beside the service desk's Escalate Ticket: that moves a Ticket's priority; this owns the ladder. Automation is attributed (`raisedByPolicy`).

```ts
import EscalateCaseCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/commands/escalate-case-command';

await new EscalateCaseCommand(commandContext).execute({
  subject: kase,
  current: latestEscalation, // the rung is read from it
  toLevelKey: 'L3',
  reason: 'sla-risk',
  raisedBy: agent,
  targetRole: l3OnCall,
});
```

### Non-goals

No notification to the receiving level; cards have no way to send one, so the Escalation's acknowledgement clock is the surface.
